name: gap-demo-video
description: Remotion + GSAP product demo of the Old Navy QuickFit 3D viewer, rendered to assets/images/gap for the case card and hero.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts QuickFitDemo out/quickfit-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --pixel-format yuv420p
scripts.poster: remotion still src/index.ts QuickFitDemo out/quickfit-demo-poster.jpg --frame 330 --image-format jpeg --jpeg-quality 82
